scope: Structural learning architecture for official IU5 2026 semester-1 courses and NIR. This file does not invent an official syllabus where only the curriculum title is verified.

policy.readinessRule: Worst critical prerequisite gate wins; no averaging across critical gates.
policy.unassessedRule: Missing diagnostic evidence remains UNASSESSED and must never be converted to 0/100.

contentClaimLevels.official_identity: Directly mirrored from the official 2026 curriculum only.
contentClaimLevels.public_course_evidence: Supported by a public IU5 learning page/material, but not promoted to a complete official 2026 syllabus.
contentClaimLevels.existing_repo_reuse: Existing Bauman Hub content reused as preparation/support.
contentClaimLevels.bridge_inference: Competency bridge inferred from course title + prerequisite graph; explicitly not an official syllabus claim.
contentClaimLevels.suggested_evidence: Recommended learner artifact for study control; not an official Bauman submission requirement unless separately verified.

sourceCatalog.caveat: Public IU5 material supports queueing-theory preparation; it is not treated as a complete locked 2026 master syllabus.
Public NIR guidance is used as study evidence only; exact cohort-2026 submission rules must be confirmed with the supervisor/department.
